id: \bYo, this league sucks.
en: \bYo, this league sucks.
it: \bEhi, questa Lega fa schifo.

id: \rYo, down with the league.
en: \rYo, down with the league.
it: \rEhi, abbasso la Lega.

id: \bTurtonator
en: \bTurtonator
it: \bTurtonator

id: \bJames: Welcome to our shop.
en: \bJames: Welcome to our shop.
it: \bJames: Benvenuti nel nostro negozio.

id: \rLillie: Don't worry about us.
en: \rLillie: Don't worry about us.
it: \rLylia: Non preoccuparti per noi.

id: \rMallow: Are you ready, \PN?
en: \rMallow: Are you ready, \PN?
it: \rIbis: Sei pronto, \PN?

id: \rMallow: Lana is my opponent. This isn't good.
en: \rMallow: Lana is my opponent. This isn't good.
it: \rIbis: La mia avversaria è Suiren. Non va bene.

id: \rMallow: Lana beat me. I'm rooting for her.
en: \rMallow: Lana beat me. I'm rooting for her.
it: \rIbis: Suiren mi ha battuta. Faccio il tifo per lei.

id: \rMallow: Lana was defeated. That Guzma sure is strong.
en: \rMallow: Lana was defeated. That Guzma sure is strong.
it: \rIbis: Suiren è stata sconfitta. Quel Guzman è davvero forte.

id: \rMallow: The finals, huh? You've got this.
en: \rMallow: The finals, huh? You've got this.
it: \rIbis: La finale, eh? Ce la puoi fare.

id: \rJessie: We'll figure something out.
en: \rJessie: We'll figure something out.
it: \rJessie: Ci inventeremo qualcosa.

id: \rJessie: Obviously I should win.
en: \rJessie: Obviously I should win.
it: \rJessie: Ovviamente dovrei vincere io.

id: \rJessie: Wobbuffet shouldn't have lost. You can't lose now.
en: \rJessie: Wobbuffet shouldn't have lost. You can't lose now.
it: \rJessie: Wobbuffet non avrebbe dovuto perdere. Adesso non puoi perdere.

id: \rMallow: Don't slow down.
en: \rMallow: Don't slow down.
it: \rIbis: Non rallentare.

id: It's a Naganadel. Would you like to take it with you?
en: It's a Naganadel. Would you like to take it with you?
it: È un Naganadel. Vuoi portarlo con te?

id: \rStock up on items. They might just save you.
en: \rStock up on items. They might just save you.
it: \rFai scorta di strumenti. Potrebbero salvarti.

id: \rJessie: How can we help you?
en: \rJessie: How can we help you?
it: \rJessie: Come possiamo aiutarti?

id: \bGladion: This is ours.
en: \bGladion: This is ours.
it: \bIridio: Questa è nostra.

id: \bTupp: Yo, the boss is going to love that we're destroying this league. Forget Kukui and his dumb dream.
en: \bTupp: Yo, the boss is going to love that we're destroying this league. Forget Kukui and his dumb dream.
it: \bTupp: Ehi, al capo piacerà un sacco che stiamo distruggendo questa Lega. Al diavolo Kukui e il suo stupido sogno.

id: \bTupp: No way. Yo, this isn't cool. Let's get out of here.
en: \bTupp: No way. Yo, this isn't cool. Let's get out of here.
it: \bTupp: Non ci credo. Yo, così non è figo. Filiamo via di qui.

id: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
en: \bWelcome. Where would you like to go?
it: \bBenvenuto. Dove vorresti andare?

id: \bForget about the battles. Do you see everything they are selling here?
en: \bForget about the battles. Do you see everything they are selling here?
it: \bLascia perdere le lotte. Hai visto tutto quello che vendono qui?

id: \bIlima: This isn't the Kalos League, but it looks promising.
en: \bIlima: This isn't the Kalos League, but it looks promising.
it: \bIlima: Non è la Lega di Kalos, ma sembra promettente.

id: \bIlima: Top 16. No surprise, but exciting.
en: \bIlima: Top 16. No surprise, but exciting.
it: \bIlima: Top 16. Nessuna sorpresa, ma è emozionante.

id: \bIlima: Guzma wiped the floor with me. Be careful if you go up against him.
en: \bIlima: Guzma wiped the floor with me. Be careful if you go up against him.
it: \bIlima: Guzman mi ha fatto a pezzi. Stai attento se dovessi affrontarlo.

id: \bIlima: Guzma wiped the floor with me. Be careful.
en: \bIlima: Guzma wiped the floor with me. Be careful.
it: \bIlima: Guzman mi ha fatto a pezzi. Stai attento.

id: \bIlima: The finals at last. Good luck to you.
en: \bIlima: The finals at last. Good luck to you.
it: \bIlima: Finalmente la finale. Buona fortuna.

id: \bSophocles: We can handle this one.
en: \bSophocles: We can handle this one.
it: \bChrys: Questa possiamo gestirla.

id: \bMy team is going to be unstoppable. I have only a Geodude.
en: \bMy team is going to be unstoppable. I have only a Geodude.
it: \bLa mia squadra sarà inarrestabile. Ho solo un Geodude.

id: \bMy Geodude wasn't enough...
en: \bMy Geodude wasn't enough...
it: \bIl mio Geodude non è bastato...

id: \rOlivia: Help somewhere else!
en: \rOlivia: Help somewhere else!
it: \rOlivia: Andate ad aiutare da un'altra parte!

id: \bZipp: Yo yo yo.
en: \bZipp: Yo yo yo.
it: \bZipp: Yo yo yo.

id: \rThat shop looks... so empty to me. \nWhat do you think?
en: \rThat shop looks... so empty to me. \nWhat do you think?
it: \rQuel negozio mi sembra... così vuoto. \nTu che ne pensi?

id: \rThat shop looks shady to me.\nWhat do you think?
en: \rThat shop looks shady to me.\nWhat do you think?
it: \rQuel negozio mi sembra losco.\nTu che ne pensi?

id: \rMina: Ah... sorry, got distracted. What do you need?
en: \rMina: Ah... sorry, got distracted. What do you need?
it: \rMina: Ah... scusa, mi sono distratta. Di cosa hai bisogno?

id: \rMina: I made it. Next round should be something.
en: \rMina: I made it. Next round should be something.
it: \rMina: Ce l'ho fatta. Il prossimo turno dovrebbe essere interessante.

id: \rMina: I lost. Oh well.
en: \rMina: I lost. Oh well.
it: \rMina: Ho perso. Pazienza.

id: \bKiawe: Our burning hearts will prevail.
en: \bKiawe: Our burning hearts will prevail.
it: \bKiawe: I nostri cuori ardenti trionferanno.

id: \bKiawe: I need to get in some extra training.
en: \bKiawe: I need to get in some extra training.
it: \bKiawe: Devo fare un po' di allenamento extra.

id: \bKiawe: Top 16 is only the beginning. Don't lose before we get a chance to let loose.
en: \bKiawe: Top 16 is only the beginning. Don't lose before we get a chance to let loose.
it: \bKiawe: La Top 16 è solo l'inizio. Non perdere prima che possiamo scatenarci.

id: \bKiawe: Sophocles and I are battling next. Wish us luck.
en: \bKiawe: Sophocles and I are battling next. Wish us luck.
it: \bKiawe: Io e Chrys lottiamo tra poco. Augurateci buona fortuna.

id: \bKiawe: Lets meet in the finals, \PN.
en: \bKiawe: Lets meet in the finals, \PN.
it: \bKiawe: Ci vediamo in finale, \PN.

id: \bKiawe: I may be out, but you still have a chance. Don't waste it.
en: \bKiawe: I may be out, but you still have a chance.  Don't waste it.
it: \bKiawe: Io sarò anche fuori, ma tu hai ancora una possibilità.  Non sprecarla.

id: \bNeed to practice. No time for distractions.
en: \bNeed to practice. No time for distractions.
it: \bDevo esercitarmi. Niente tempo per le distrazioni.

id: \bDistractions are everywhere.
en: \bDistractions are everywhere.
it: \bLe distrazioni sono ovunque.

id: \bNanu: Stay back, kid. Don't want you getting hurt.
en: \bNanu: Stay back, kid. Don't want you getting hurt.
it: \bNanu: Stai indietro, ragazzino. Non voglio che ti faccia male.

id: \rRapp: Yo, what do you think you're doing?
en: \rRapp: Yo, what do you think you're doing?
it: \rRapp: Yo, che cavolo credi di fare?

id: \bFaba: Hmm, a Battle Royal. I'll need a good strategy to move on.
en: \bFaba: Hmm, a Battle Royal. I'll need a good strategy to move on.
it: \bVicio: Mmh, un Battle Royal. Mi servirà una buona strategia per andare avanti.

id: \bFaba: No hard feelings, but I'm going to have to crush you. The prize is too good to pass up.
en: \bFaba: No hard feelings, but I'm going to have to crush you. The prize is too good to pass up.
it: \bVicio: Senza rancore, ma dovrò stracciarti. Il premio è troppo allettante per lasciarselo sfuggire.

id: \bFaba: Though I lost, I'm not upset. Another opportunity will come.
en: \bFaba: Though I lost, I'm not upset. Another opportunity will come.
it: \bVicio: Anche se ho perso, non sono turbato. Ci sarà un'altra occasione.

id: \bFaba: Personally, I'd like young master Gladion to win.
en: \bFaba: Personally, I'd like young master Gladion to win.
it: \bVicio: Personalmente, vorrei che vincesse il signorino Iridio.

id: \rLana: It's only one. I think we can manage.
en: \rLana: It's only one. I think we can manage.
it: \rSuiren: È solo uno. Credo che ce la possiamo fare.

id: \bGuzma: What do you want, punk?
en: \bGuzma: What do you want, punk?
it: \bGuzman: Che vuoi, teppistello?

id: \bGuzma: Get lost. I don't have time for you.
en: \bGuzma: Get lost. I don't have time for you.
it: \bGuzman: Sparisci. Non ho tempo da perdere con te.

id: \bGuzma: I'll crush you the moment you step foot in the ring.
en: \bGuzma: I'll crush you the moment you step foot in the ring.
it: \bGuzman: Ti distruggerò appena metterai piede sul ring.

id: \bHau: Haha, you're here. Time for that rematch, isn't it?
en: \bHau: Haha, you're here. Time for that rematch, isn't it?
it: \bHau: Ahah, sei qui. È ora di quella rivincita, no?

id: \bHau: I'm fighting Samson. Sounds fun.
en: \bHau: I'm fighting Samson. Sounds fun.
it: \bHau: Lotterò contro Samson. Sembra divertente.

id: \bHau: I guess it's you against me next match. I won't lose with my grandfather watching.
en: \bHau: I guess it's you against me next match. I won't lose with my grandfather watching.
it: \bHau: A quanto pare il prossimo incontro siamo io e te. Non perderò con mio nonno che guarda.

id: \bHau: You beat me. I'm rooting for you.
en: \bHau: You beat me. I'm rooting for you.
it: \bHau: Mi hai battuto. Faccio il tifo per te.

id: \bHau: I'm counting on you to win.
en: \bHau: I'm counting on you to win.
it: \bHau: Conto su di te per la vittoria.

id: \bHau: We've got this!
en: \bHau: We've got this!
it: \bHau: Ce la possiamo fare!

id: \rHapu: Gotta focus.
en: \rHapu: Gotta focus.
it: \rHapu: Devo concentrarmi.

id: \bMarowak
en: \bMarowak
it: \bMarowak

id: \bWobbuffet!
en: \bWobbuffet!
it: \bWobbuffet!

id: \bHala: Us Kahuna's can handle this.
en: \bHala: Us Kahuna's can handle this.
it: \bHala: Noi Kahuna possiamo occuparcene.

id: \rTsareena
en: \rTsareena
it: \rTsareena

id: \bJames: What's our plan?
en: \bJames: What's our plan?
it: \bJames: Qual è il nostro piano?

id: \bJames:... I suppose I'll lose.
en: \bJames:... I suppose I'll lose.
it: \bJames:... Immagino che perderò.

id: \bJames: I can win this next match.
en: \bJames: I can win this next match.
it: \bJames: Il prossimo incontro posso vincerlo.

id: \bMasked Royal: Good, help from our new Champion. Don't hold back.
en: \bMasked Royal: Good, help from our new Champion.  Don't hold back.
it: \bReale Mascherato: Bene, l'aiuto del nostro nuovo Campione.  Non trattenerti.

id: \bKukui: Good job, Champion. The Guzzlord...
en: \bKukui: Good job, Champion. The Guzzlord...
it: \bKukui: Ottimo lavoro, Campione. Il Guzzlord...

id: \bWait, where's my mask!? How did it... I guess you deserve the truth, \PN. I've been the Masked Royal the entire time.
en: \bWait, where's my mask!? How did it... I guess you deserve the truth, \PN. I've been the Masked Royal the entire time.
it: \bAspetta, dov'è la mia maschera!? Come ha fatto a... Immagino tu meriti la verità, \PN. Sono sempre stato io il Reale Mascherato.

id: \bThat won't change our exhibition match any. In fact, let's make it a full battle.
en: \bThat won't change our exhibition match any. In fact, let's make it a full battle.
it: \bQuesto non cambierà affatto il nostro incontro di esibizione. Anzi, facciamone una lotta completa.

id: \bKukui: Let's make it a full battle.
en: \bKukui: Let's make it a full battle.
it: \bKukui: Facciamone una lotta completa.
